name: ip-legal
description: Trademark clearance, freedom-to-operate triage, cease-and-desist drafting, patent claim charts, OSS license scanning, and DMCA compliance.
author: Anthropic

skills.name: cold-start-interview
skills.description: Initial practice profile setup — learns your IP portfolio, enforcement posture, and prosecution preferences in 10-15 minutes

skills.name: clearance
skills.description: Trademark clearance search and risk assessment for a new mark, brand name, or product name

skills.name: cease-desist
skills.description: Draft a cease-and-desist letter for trademark infringement, copyright infringement, or trade secret misappropriation

skills.name: claim-chart
skills.description: Map patent claims to an accused product or process in a structured claim chart

skills.name: oss-scan
skills.description: Review an open-source dependency manifest for license compatibility, copyleft obligations, and notice requirements

skills.name: dmca
skills.description: Draft DMCA takedown notices or counter-notifications; review safe harbor compliance for platform clients

skills.name: fto-triage
skills.description: Freedom-to-operate triage — identify relevant patents and surface design-around options for a described product or feature
